products.base_note_description_quote: Every Parfums de Marly release is named after a horse bred for the aristocracy... mostly on the strength of a vanilla-and-apple opening most people don't expect from something this polished.

official_notes_quote.base: Base Notes Patchouli, Vanilla, Guaicwood, Praline

products.maker_words: Layton blends the freshness of apple with calming lavender, wrapped in the earthy depth of patchouli. Elegant, sensual and flamboyant.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note lists Bergamot as top/Lavender as top and Cardamom as base; the official pyramid puts Cardamom in the top and Lavender in the heart. Base Note's heart lists Jasmine (not on the current official pyramid at all) and its base adds Sandalwood and Pepper while dropping Patchouli and Praline, both of which the manufacturer names as base notes.

products.base_note_description_quote: Pegasus goes back further than most Parfums de Marly names... it opens with an unusual pairing of bitter almond and cumin against bergamot, before settling into amber, vanilla, and sandalwood.

official_notes_quote.heart: Heart Notes Cypress, Violet Leaves, Orange Blossom

products.maker_words: Pegasus opens with radiant bergamot, softened by the smoothness of almond, and unfolds into a warm, captivating vanilla base. Vibrant, addictive and sensual.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note's top notes (Bitter Almond, Heliotrope) don't match the official pyramid's Anise and Almond; Base Note's heart (Lavender, Jasmine) doesn't appear on the current official pyramid at all, which lists Cypress, Violet Leaves and Orange Blossom instead. Base Note also names Guaiac Wood in the base where the manufacturer names Ambrox.

products.base_note_description_quote: By the time Althaïr launched, Parfums de Marly had run through most of its stock of noble horse names... Cinnamon and orange blossom open it, praline and candied almond close it out.

official_notes_quote.heart: Heart Notes Orange Blossom, Cinnamon, Cardamom
official_notes_quote.base: Base Notes Bourbon Vanilla, Guaicwood, Praline

products.maker_words: Althaïr combines the smoothness of vanilla, the indulgence of praline, and the brightness of orange blossom. Elegant, generous and charismatic.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note lists Passionfruit as a top note and Heliotrope in the heart, neither of which appears on the official pyramid, which instead opens with Bergamot/Mandarin/Elemi and hearts Orange Blossom/Cinnamon/Cardamom. Base Note also places Praline in the heart while the manufacturer names it a base note, and Base Note's base (Tonka Bean, White Musk) doesn't match the official base (Bourbon Vanilla, Guaicwood, Praline).

products.base_note_description_quote: Perseus is built around a very specific image: sunrise at the Château de Marly... it opens bright with grapefruit and blackcurrant, then pivots hard into dry, cashmere-soft woods.

official_notes_quote.base: Base notes Vetiver, Amberwood, Grey Amber

products.maker_words: Perseus combines bright grapefruit, fresh geranium, and refined vetiver. Bright, invigorating and refined.
products.store_mismatch: Base Note adds Green Apple to the top notes and Lavender/Violet Leaf to the heart, none of which appear on the official pyramid; the official heart instead names Blackcurrant Bud (which Base Note's prose mentions but leaves off its formal note list), and the official base leads with Vetiver, which Base Note's base list omits in favor of generic 'Woody Notes.' Note: the manufacturer's own product page does not display an olfactive-family tag for Perseus the way it does for the other four (those were cross-referenced from related-product cards on sibling pages), so families is left empty rather than guessed.

products.base_note_description_quote: Every Parfums de Marly fragrance takes its name from a horse bred for nobility... a cold, sharp opening that gives way to warmth, then settles into something dark and smoky, the kind of depth built for winter nights and old stone rooms.

official_notes_quote.heart: Heart Notes Saffron, Praline, Lavender, Clary Sage
official_notes_quote.base: Base Notes Oud, Patchouli, Vetiver, Leather

products.maker_words: Haltane opens with the aromatic freshness of bergamot and lavender, reveals a subtle gourmand praline heart, then intensifies into the depth of oud. Sophisticated, audacious and powerful.
products.store_mismatch: None found — Base Note's top/heart/base notes match the official pyramid exactly.
